Senior capstone · AERSP 403A/B · Fall 2026 to Spring 2027

M.A.R.V. capstone drone

Our senior capstone is a fully autonomous quadcopter built as a prototype for Mars sample return. It flies indoors with no GPS, finds a coded package among decoys, picks it up with a magnetic mechanism and flies a return path uploaded mid-flight. The payload mechanism is my main design piece.

In progress PDR and CDR done; risk matrix and QR software under wayOnshape and CAD · FDM printing in PLA · Raspberry Pi 4 and Navio2 · ArduPilot
